details.eligibility: Bachelor's degree; age 21–40 years (UP rules; relaxations apply).
details.pattern: Prelims: GS I (150 questions) + CSAT (qualifying). Mains: 8 papers (Essay, Hindi, GS I–VI). Interview: 100 marks.
details.syllabus: UP GK, Polity, History, Geography, Economy, Current Affairs.
details.important_dates: UPPSC PCS Prelims 2025 held 12 Oct 2025; UPPSC PCS Prelims 2026 scheduled 6 Dec 2026 (per YouTube/UPPSC updates — verify on uppsc.up.nic.in).
